result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior blocker F-05-001 and directly touched surfaces. The production edit path now refuses turnless/no-membership messages before applying record changes, added a regression test for that case, and the story and epic gates pass.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: messages.edit now enforces target.turnStatus === 'closed' before applyMessageEdit runs. Code at packages/lhc/src/domains/messages/index.ts:425-443 returns caller_error turn_open for both open-turn and turnless targets; packages/lhc/src/domains/messages/internal/store.ts:48-53 documents that null turnStatus is refused under the closed-turn target boundary. Test coverage was added at packages/lhc/test/mutations.test.ts:481-504: a runtime_note before any turn creates m1 with no turnId, edit returns ok:false/code turn_open, and the full snapshot remains unchanged. I also re-ran the prior ad hoc scenario and observed ok:false turn_open with unchanged before/after read-back.

verified: F-05-001 convergence: turnless/no-membership edit refused with unchanged read-back via code, test, and ad hoc runtime scenario.
TC-5.1 through TC-5.6 remain covered by mutations.test.ts and cli-process-mutations.test.ts from initial verification; focused test suites pass after the fix.

additionalObservations: No new fake adapter, mock path, shim, placeholder, or non-real runtime behavior was found in the directly touched edit validation path.

The turnless refusal uses the existing turn_open code with a distinct reason string; this is consistent with the implementor fix and closes the closed-turn boundary gap without adding a new error code outside the story contract.
